title: Bear vs Lion: Who Would Win? The Animals 🐻🦁 (Would Meatball Survive?)
description:
Bear versus lion, who would win? The animals. The Smithsonian's National Zoo says a male African lion weighs 330 to 550 pounds. At Katmai National Park and Preserve, the U.S. Park Service says most adult male brown bears typically weigh 600 to 900 pounds in mid-summer, and that large adult males can weigh well over 1,000 pounds by October and November. A big coastal brown bear would probably win on size. Nobody has tested it. Inland grizzly weights overlap a male lion's range, and agencies do not agree on a single bear top speed.

Timed for Thanksgiving, November 26, 2026. This is about the animals.

#bear #lion #grizzly #meatballmyths #shorts

Sources: Smithsonian's National Zoo; San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance lion fact sheet; U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; U.S. National Park Service (Katmai, Yellowstone, Glacier, Staying Safe Around Bears). General information, not a predicted fight.
